snippet.title: NO SUCH FLOOR — Official Trailer | Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
Some floors shouldn't exist. Some doors should never open.

Welcome to Amisos Hotel. Your job is simple: help guests, complete your night shifts, and keep everything running smoothly.

But something is wrong with this hotel.

Explore the unsettling halls of NO SUCH FLOOR, a psychological horror game where ordinary hotel duties slowly turn into something far more disturbing. Can you make it through the night?

🎮 PLAY THE FREE DEMO ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5131470/No_Such_Floor/

👀 If you enjoy the game, don't forget to wishlist it on Steam to support its development!

💬 Join our Discord and follow the development:
https://discord.gg/pKxyZBeehA

Developed by QuasART Games.

#NoSuchFloor #HorrorGame #IndieGame
